base_dir.description: Root directory where history data, logs, and configuration are stored.

path.description: Full path to the SQLite database file.

max_size_mb.description: Maximum size (in MB) before database auto-truncation or rotation (0 = unlimited).

journal_mode.description: SQLite journal mode. 'wal' is recommended for better concurrency.

pool_size.description: Maximum number of simultaneous connections to the database.

level.description: Minimum log level (DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, CRITICAL).

file.description: Path to the log file. Empty string disables file logging.

console.description: Whether to log to standard output (console).

max_file_size_mb.description: Maximum size (in MB) of each log file before rotation.

max_file_count.description: Number of rotated log files to keep.

host.description: IP address to bind the service to (e.g., '127.0.0.1' for local only, '::' for all IPv6).

api_port.description: TCP port for the REST API endpoint.

metrics_port.description: TCP port for the Prometheus-compatible metrics endpoint.

tls_cert.description: Path to the TLS certificate file (required if TLS is enabled).

tls_key.description: Path to the TLS private key file (required if TLS is enabled).

enabled.description: Enable gzip compression for API responses.

min_size.description: Minimum response body size (in bytes) to trigger compression.

processes.description: Number of worker processes (0 = auto-detect based on CPU cores).

threads.description: Number of threads per worker process.

max_requests.description: Maximum number of requests a worker processes before restarting (helps prevent memory leaks).

worker_timeout.description: Seconds before a worker is terminated and restarted on hang (e.g., deadlock or long blocking I/O).

retention.description: Data retention and automatic cleanup settings

message_days.description: Number of days to keep messages (0 = retain indefinitely).

call_days.description: Number of days to keep call records (0 = retain indefinitely).

prune_enabled.description: Enable automatic removal of expired records.

prune_schedule.description: Cron expression for when to run pruning (e.g., '0 3 * * *' = daily at 3:00 AM UTC).

origins.description: List of allowed origin domains (e.g., ['https://example.com']). Empty = allow all (⚠️ not recommended for production).

items.description: A valid origin URL (scheme + domain, e.g., 'https://app.example.com')

allow_credentials.description: Whether to allow cookies/authentication headers in CORS requests.

ttl_seconds.description: Time-to-live for cache entries in seconds.

stats_enabled.description: Enable collection of cache hit/miss statistics for metrics.
